label: A
summary: Total CNY debited from the China account, including any CNY-side fixed fee.

label: F_cny
summary: Fixed fees deducted in CNY before conversion, translated consistently.

label: r_customer
summary: Provider's effective USD per CNY rate actually applied to the converted amount. If quoted as CNY per USD q, use r_customer = 1/q only when q is the all-in customer rate with no hidden adjustment.

label: m
summary: Independent mid-market USD per CNY reference at the same timestamp, used only for comparison.

label: F_usd
summary: USD fees deducted after conversion, including disclosed intermediary/receiving charges where known.

label: Delivered USD
summary: D = (A - F_cny) × r_customer - F_usd

label: FX spread cost in USD
summary: Spread = (A - F_cny) × (m - r_customer)

label: Total execution cost versus fee-free mid-market conversion
summary: Execution cost = A × m - D = F_cny × m + Spread + F_usd

label: Carrying cash avoids tax and reporting.
summary: China exit limits/permits and US entry reporting still apply; underlying income/FX tax is separate.

label: The new US 1% remittance excise applies to money arriving from China.
summary: The verified IRS scope concerns specified physical-instrument-funded remittances sent from the US to foreign recipients; do not add it to an inbound wire by default.

label: A company, trust, insurance policy or QDII product is a free repatriation wrapper.
summary: These are genuine legal/investment arrangements with their own controls and potential US reporting; they do not create a general right to move unrelated savings abroad.
